zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: 设置界面、明暗外观与磁力桌面交互更新
changes: 重新整理设置导航、截图历史、工作区、工具栏和存储管理，支持调整窗口大小
新增跟随系统、浅色和深色外观，保存选择并在启动时应用
磁力桌面收起入口支持悬浮卡片堆、四边吸附、跨屏移动及空闲后进一步收起
新增弹性与弧线动画，保留简洁动画和减少动态效果
修复多显示器首次截图及跨屏复用时的选区定位
磁力桌面依赖截图历史；应用与 DMG 已通过 Apple 公证

en.label: Latest
en.title: Settings, appearance, and Magnetic Desktop interaction updates
changes: Reorganized Settings navigation, capture history, workspaces, toolbar controls, and storage management, with a resizable window.
Added system, light, and dark appearance modes, saved and applied on launch.
The folded Magnetic Desktop handle supports a floating card stack, docking to all four edges, moving between displays, and further folding while idle.
Added elastic and arc animations while retaining simple animations and reduced motion support.
Fixed selection positioning on the first capture and when reusing the overlay across displays.
Magnetic Desktop requires screenshot history. The app and DMG are Apple-notarized.
